name: Skybiotech Healthcare Limited
about: Skybiotech Healthcare Limited engages in textile and allied businesses in India. It also deals in shares and securities, as well as provides consultancy and assistance services in selling the goods of foreign clients. The company was formerly known as Kapil Cotex Limited and changed its name to Skybiotech Healthcare Limited in November 2025. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Aurangabad, India.
